comparisons.distinction: Affix-based source reduction has no rejection/cue S2C. Here actual current-tool compatibility branch first caps/scales damage then conditionally emits an oriented live-target-attached receipt; config predicate and geometry availability decide emission. Scalar constants alone add0.

Wizardry explicit spell resist is an elemental rejection table and localized player message. Here it is a partial reduction branch without final immunity reason, broadcast to nearby clients and attached to target using computed hit-side offset.

Tetra first control cue ignores addEffect result; here no control effect request: tool eligibility/target marker causes scalar modification and geometric receipt before later damage adjustments. Shared warning that cue is not success is support0, not the proposed distinction by itself.

Dummy packet includes measured/recorded amount and source/crit and starts an independent billboard. Here payload has entity/dimension plus offset/normal but no damage amount/reason; particle follows live target with fixed world-space normal and ends on dead target.
ToroHealth observes client HP deltas, accumulates and shows independent moving text. This server branch can emit before actual HP change and translates with target during its own animation lifetime.

MineAndSlash explicit DODGE/RESIST enum goes to attacker and uses independent text strategy. Here partial compatibility reduction goes to radius32 clients, requires hit-offset availability, and transports an oriented target-attached marker without explicit outcome enum.

ColdSweat reads stored last attacker for knockback-only output. Here current true-source living hand/tool qualifies damage reduction and feedback before final damage; separate knockback helper is supporting context0.

dedup_snapshot.separate_from_batches007_to010: No shield faces, puppet payer, collision-phase capability or charging timer. AttackDamageHandler was previously supporting gem call-site context only; this new candidate is its native tool-reduction producer plus actual message/particle lifecycle.

full_chain: Registries and mod preInit/init activate config, entity/item/sound registration, network channel/MessageRegistry and AttackDamageHandler. Concrete BloodSnail constructor is IEntityBL and registered by EntityRegistry; interface is empty marker. This is one policy across marker mobs, not per-mob units.

OverworldItemHandler.isToolWeakened requires GENERAL.useToolWeakness and blToolWeakness gamerule. Whitelist first overrides blacklists. Config ItemListProperty parses registry-name+metadata/wildcard, initialized by ConfigHelper reflected initProperties; default lists empty. Default blacklist is ItemTool/ItemSword/ItemBow excluding local BL subclasses and ItemRegistry.ITEMS. Gamerule defaulttrue installed at server start, lookup prefers dimension0 world then client world fallback; no-rule/null false.

Actual LivingHurt handler requires victim IEntityBL, true source EntityLivingBase and current getActiveHand()!=null. It reads that current held stack, not projectile launch snapshot. Empty OR weakened tool caps damage at40; nonempty weakened tool multiplies0.3. Empty cap does not call tool config predicate when short-circuited. Handler has no victim-dimension equality check. Separate knockback callback multiplies strength0.3 for a nonempty current weakened tool; not separate credit.

Only server builds feedback. Target center is pos+height/2. For immediate null or same as living attacker, it first intersects target AABB with eye/look segment length10. If no offset and immediate nonnull, falls back to immediate center minus target center. Only nonnull offset emits sound and message. Horizontal normalized offset is scaled by target.width; y preserves impact-relative-height, and normal uses scaled normalized horizontal direction. Target dimension/position/radius32 route the packet.

Cue is sent before CircleGemHelper handleAttack, ring-of-power multipliers, thorns side effects and final event.setAmount. The packet encodes no amount, successbool or explicit immunity reason. It therefore acknowledges this compatibility-reduction branch, not final damage/HP decrease or total immunity. Gem/ring internals are preexisting contextual boundaries, not a second proposal.

MessageRegistry registers CLIENT and schedules process on client main thread. MessageBase wraps PacketBuffer codec. MessageEntity sends signed-byte count then integer entityID+dimension; client resolves only current world with matching dimension. MessageDamageReductionParticle adds six doubles offset/dir; process calls parent resolution and only nonnull entity creates actual particle. No UUID, epoch, sequence, retry or finite-vector validation in this packet.

AttackDamageHandler.spawn uses BLParticles.DAMAGE_REDUCTION factory scale2 and three data values(entity,offset,normal). Factory base fourth value is maxAge=-1; actual combineArgs preserves supplied first3 and fills fourth default. Constructor captures target reference, pos/prevPos=target+offset, random angle and rotation direction; factory sets RGBA defaults and submits to native effectRenderer.addEffect.

ParticleDamageReduction update calls animated parent, rotates by age/16 then follows live target+fixed offset; null/dead target expires. Animated parent uses stitched frames and sets maxAge=total frame duration-1 when initial<0. Client preInit registers factory stitcher; TextureStitchHandler pre loads split frame metadata and post invokes callback; actual pixels/resources were not opened or modified. TextureAnimation sums durations/advances frame; exact displayed lifetime depends on loaded frames/native Particle tick, not a claimed constant.

Program render method interpolates prior/current positions minus camera origin and builds quad basis from world-up cross fixed normal, rotates vertices around normal, writes texture/color/lightmap. shouldDisableDepth returnsfalse, getFXLayer1. Not camera-facing text and not a regenerated hit direction each tick. Native particle engine rendering, depth enforcement, packet timing, real audio and image quality remain unexecuted boundaries.
critical_boundaries: No damage-success predicate or positive-amount check before feedback. Later handlers/modifiers/cancellation may change outcome; event.setAmount is after this cue. No health delta or final receipt identity.

No direct dimension restriction in this damage callback despite config prose saying in the dimension. Actual loaded config/native getActiveHand semantics and hit flow not executed; do not assume all ordinary attacks enter this branch.
Current source held item, not source projectile equipment snapshot; changing equipment between launch and impact can change qualification in this method. No runtime demonstration.

Empty held stack caps40 even if toolWeakness disabled because OR short circuit; it does not emit the nonempty weakened cue. Nonempty accepted tool leaves this branch unchanged. Conditional illustration only.

If immediate null and ray misses, damage reduction can occur with no sound/packet. Immediate fallback gives source center direction, not actual collision contact. Source vertically aligned yields zero horizontal normal; no guard before basis cross products, possible degenerate quad from code, not observed rendering bug.

Offset and normal fixed in world axes, target position follows each tick but target yaw/pose does not rotate or recompute them. Only target isEntityAlive checked locally; no explicit dimension/world-generation check on particle retained reference. Native engine world cleanup not inspected.
No emission cooldown, event dedup or per-target hard cap here. Every received valid packet can add another particle; general engine limits not expanded. No retransmission claim.

Stitched lifetime is dependent on metadata; missing/unanimated/zero-frame cases not certified. setSplitAnimations ignores its boolean argument and always sets true, but this caller requests true. No exact duration or asset quality claim.

Config helper migration/remapper internals and native configuration loading are not end-to-end executed. Generic registry getters, Particle engine and Forge hurt ordering remain explicit external boundaries, not reference units.

Render/source-only inspection; no model/texture/audio file edits or asset copying. Sound cue registry declaration verified, actual sounds.json/audio playback not audited in011. Geometry/code submission does not establish visible effect.
Entire reduction decision/conditional producer/message/target lifecycle max1, not separate damage/knockback/config/packet/particle/helper credit.
